brief:
The Israeli military spokesperson announced the conclusion of the 98th Division's operations in the West Bank, the Ma'an news agency reported. The unit conducted more than 1,500 operations during its deployment in the territory.

According to the military, the division detained 140 Palestinians over the course of its mission. No information was released regarding when the unit would redeploy or which forces would replace it.
title: Israeli military ends 98th Division operations in West Bank after 1,500 activities
